newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW - Ifo April business climate index.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Ifo April business climate index.

text.p: The Ifo economic research institute said its April west German business climate index climbed to 94.7 from 92.6. Following are analysts comments:
GERNOT NERB, SENIOR ECONOMIST, SALOMON BROTHERS:

"Of course this is a really good number. We had expected an improvement because the drop we saw in March was only a distortion in an upward trend. I would expect that mainly the export sector has boosted the index because construction and retailing remians very sluggish."

Speaking about Bonn's efforts to qualify for EMU, Nerb said, "At the moment without corrective measures the (budget) deficit is around 3.3 percent, so they have to think of some extra measures. A moderate increase in mineral oil tax is perhaps still possible after this weekend's meeting of the Free Democrats." Uwe Angenendt, Economist, BHF-Bank :

"This is a really good number and this number now fits better with the economic indicators we have already seen in the first quarter in production and incoming orders. All in all this figure reflects the actual economic situation in Germany better. I think that in the coming months favourable news from the economy in Germany will be negative for the bond market. I think we will see a weakening of the mark because the weakening of the German bargaining position in the EMU process will weigh on the mark."
